NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EcoMap uses your location to place pollution reports on the map and to show reports near you.
NSCameraUsageDescription: EcoMap uses the camera to photograph pollution and cleaned areas.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EcoMap does not read your photo library; to prevent fake photos, all photos are taken with the in-app camera.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: EcoMap only uses your location while the app is open, to place pollution reports on the map. It does not track your location in the background.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: EcoMap only uses your location while the app is open, to place pollution reports on the map. It does not track your location in the background.
NSMotionUsageDescription: EcoMap counts your steps in the Eco-Mobility section to reward walking with EcoPoints.
